The Tenant shall not keep animals on the premises without written consent, and shall comply with all rules adopted by the Landlord for the safety of the building. At the end of the term the Tenant shall return all keys, remove all property, and leave the premises in the condition required by this agreement. The Landlord may enter the premises to show it to prospective tenants during the last two months of the term, after giving reasonable notice. Nothing in this agreement creates a partnership between the parties, and no waiver of any provision shall be treated as a waiver of any other provision.
